song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: If, in a mirror’s belly, a reflection — image-making, with its original — were proved by mind alone —
then, within the mirror of free consciousness, things have no other cause at all.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādarśakukṣau pratibimbakāri sabimbakaṃ syād yadi mānasiddham | svacchandasaṃvinmukhuraantarāle bhāveṣu hetvantaram asti nānyat

verses.craft: Mirror-belly kept bodily (udara not prettified); a-fortiori hinge; mukura reading marked per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) belly→interior → killed: belly is the words body. (b) proving mirror mechanics → killed: row 10.
